While he chases after his housemates to destroy their disco equipment, he discovers with astonishment that Asian clones of himself and the Lemmings are also engaged in a high-speed pursuit.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (65)
programme.desc: Grizzy has anticipated everything for his birthday and plans on spending a peaceful day in the cabin doing his favorite activities. But when the Lemmings find out it’s Grizzy’s birthday, they devise other plans. Farewell, Grizzy’s peaceful day - make way for the Lemmings’ party surprises!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (66)
programme.desc: Grizzy has adopted a lamb and wants to give it a proper education. The Lemmings have only one desire: play leap-frog with the baby! Grizzy is forced to play policeman and lock the Lemmings in one of the disused tower rooms. But the Lemmings find a strange machine capable of duplicating living beings. They decide to test it out on the lamb.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (67)
programme.desc: The Lemmings have fun jumping up and down on the wool of the sheep. The game turns into a nightmarewhen Grizzy’s hindquarters accidentally get shaved because of the Lemmings. Grizzy grabs a pair of shears shaves the sheep. The Lemmings’ toy is gone but they discover another sheep whose coat is even bouncier.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (68)
programme.desc: Grizzy finds a crate of Yummy flavored jelly. In order to enjoy the treat alone, he throws the Lemmings intothe dungeon. The Lemmings discover a book on Robin Hood and use it as inspiration to free themselves andsteal the bear’s feast. The Lemming archers confront Grizzy armed with a sword. May the battle begin!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (69)
programme.desc: The Lemmings have organized a magic show in the cabin living room but Grizzy wants to get comfy andwatch TV. He evicts the Lemmings who find a strange alignment of menhirs in the Scottish moor. Bystanding in a certain spot between the ancestral stones, one Lemming is transformed into a fairy. With his magic wand, he will now be able to organize a memorable new show and above all get rid of Grizzy.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (70)
programme.desc: Grizzy does not know how to put an end to the Lemmings’ new ball game. After devastating the cabinplaying dodgeball, the Lemmings admire the magic stone balls that whirl around the cabin like raginganimals. In a secret Stonehenge cavern, Grizzy discovers a glove that can stop the uncontrollable flying objects.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (71)
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings have a new game. They fight over a crown to place on a stuffed animal in theirimage. After a first epic confrontation, Grizzy recovers the crown, but his stuffed animal has been damaged.Grizzy shoos the Lemmings far away and tries to repair his royal stuffed effigy. Meanwhile, the Lemmings discover a stuffed animal factory that might allow them to retake possession of the crown and win the match.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (72)
programme.desc: Grizzy wants to take a nap but the Lemmings are goofing around astride a sheep inside the cabin. Grizzy throws the Lemmings out, but one of them is propelled into a strange crypt away from the others. When he comes into physical contact with a sharp mysterious tooth inside the crypt, the Lemming is transformed into a fearsome creature: the Were-Lemming!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (73)
programme.desc: Grizzy finds a giant crate of Yummy chocolate spread along the roadside. Using guile, he discreetly stockshis loot inside the cabin without arousing the suspicions of the Lemmings, but they quickly catch onto his ruse. Grizzy throws the Lemmings out but he knows his peace is only temporary. He must develop an efficient anti-Lemming protection system. He opts for a hen who mistakes the Yummy jars for her eggs.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (74)
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings fight over a jar of jelly. During their battle, the jar soars into the air and gets stuck in an inaccessible high-up spot. The rivals throw themselves into the construction of a tower to reach their target first. Each side has his own personal style to attain the summits, and to cheat. Due to the whims of hazard - or perhaps their rush - the jar continues to slip away from them, landing in ever-higher places. Will Grizzy and the Lemmings be up to the challenge?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (75)
programme.desc: While looking for a pack of instant gelatine in the garage, Grizzy happens upon a box of figurines. One of them looks just like him! Grizzy invents an imaginary game where his bear figurine turns into a great and powerful magician who will make a gelatine potion. The Lemmings discover that the magician has locked their figurines inside a cage. They decide to play along: the Lemmings Knights challenge the Bear Magician.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (76)
programme.desc: To celebrate Halloween, the Lemmings disguise themselves and decorate the cabin. Wanting to regaincontrol of the premises, Grizzy gets rid of the Lemmings by making them believe he too disguised himself to play. Propelled far from the cabin, the Lemmings find a magic hat that can truly turn them into whatever their costume is. All the Lemmings are delighted, except one whose costume is stuck inside the cabin.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (48)
programme.desc: Mr Bean joins Billy in trying to film his remote-controlled car so they can win an online video competition. But Mrs Wicket interrupts, asking them to set up the garden for Uncle Ron’s birthday party. While she’s off picking him up, they use the furniture to create the ultimate course for their video, but a wonky wheel on the car sends it straight into Ron’s massive birthday cake!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (49)
programme.desc: Mrs Wicket is off for the weekend, and insists Mr Bean feed her cat Scrapper at 5am and 5pm every day. The evenings are OK, but Mr Bean can’t face getting up at dawn every day just for a cat! So he plugs his old train set into a timer, set to deliver Scrapper’s food at the required times. But by unplugging Mrs Wicket’s timers, her lamps don’t activate and some burglars spot an opportunity…

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (50)
programme.desc: Mr Bean is settling in for his favourite TV show marathon when Irma rings to remind him they’re having lunch at her mum’s. He pretends to be ill, which backfires when Irma comes over to look after him - but soon he’s taking advantage of Irma who is waiting on him hand and foot. It’s all going great until Irma’s mum turns up and starts to take charge; no TV, no popcorn and worst of all - no Teddy!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (51)
programme.desc: Mr Paliwal is organising the neighbours for a street clean so they can win “Britain’s Tidiest Street”. But when the window cleaner cancels, Mr Bean sees a money-making opportunity and offers to help. He invents his own mobile window-cleaning device which works brilliantly! But rushing around with a long cleaning pole and a wheelie bin full of water might not have been the best idea when everyone’s rushing around.

programme.title: Moley (4)
programme.desc: When Dotty joins an art competition Moley is afraid her art won’t appeal to the snooty judge so he casts a spell that causes her art to "come to life!"

programme.title: Moley (5)
programme.desc: When Manny accidentally transports a heap of trash into Moletown, Moley attempts to recycle it by fixing up the town—but when he blows off Mishmosh’s directions, his repairs become a problem.

programme.title: Moley (6)
programme.desc: When Moley is given the key to the city, he has such a great day he convinces Manny to let him repeat the whole day! But when the day never stops repeating, Moley needs to find a way out.

programme.title: Moley (7)
programme.desc: When Moletown experiences a heatwave, Moley and Dotty hope Mishmosh can invent something to cool things down. Unfortunately, Mishmosh has "inventors block" so Moley and Dotty must help him get back his inventing mojo.

programme.title: Moley (8)
programme.desc: Moley must learn to Molerskate for the Great Mole Roll skating competition and discovers his parents have a hidden talent.

programme.title: Tom and Jerry (4)
programme.desc: Jerry has his eyes set on Tom’s catch of the day and is determined to stand in the way. Tom is also bent on getting a taste of the sea one way or the other! Will they sink or swim?

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables (2)
programme.desc: Chep is the only Mushable who can’t bend a small branch back to catapult himself between two trees. He feels weak and embarrassed. But when strength doesn’t work, Chep realizes that it’s all in the technique!

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables (3)
programme.desc: It seems like Starmush is the only one who can answer Mush-Mush's difficult questions. But Starmush lives so far away in the Dark Forest! Mush-Mush hatches a plan to get Starmush to move to Mushton, so he can get answers right here at home.

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables (4)
programme.desc: Lilit remembers loving balancing on a slack-vine when she was a Mushlet. But actually, she never really learnt how, so she keeps falling off and getting really frustrated. It’s up to Morel to step up and finally teach Lilit how to slack-vine like a pro.

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables (5)
programme.desc: Chep and Mush-Mush sometimes don’t listen to Lilit. So when she tries to tell them about her great idea to have a special firefly night, they instead believe it is their idea. Grrr! Whose special firefly night will come out on top?

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables (6)
programme.desc: Bolly hurts his foot and can’t go fast until it heals. Phooey! But when everyone gives him treats to cheer him up, Bolly decides he never wants his foot to heal.

programme.title: SuperThings: Rivals of Kaboom - Kazoom Power (33)
programme.desc: Hot Hot makes all the food extremely spicy and the accumulated heat threatens to blow up Professor K's volcano.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (41)
programme.desc: When Hildie receives another dozen black roses from a secret admirer, her curiosity is piqued. Sending Tom and Jerry to find out the identity of the mystery admirer, they end up at the Enchanted Flower Shop across the forest, where they encounter some frightful arrangements and a few "dead ends."

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (42)
programme.desc: After yet another unsuccessful attempt to catch Jerry, Tom falls under the influence of a traveling cat salesman named Carver, who sells him a series of elaborate mousetraps, tricks and schemes. Setting out to dish up a "world of hurt" on Jerry, Tom only managed to injure himself.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (41)
programme.desc: Dr. Bigby upgrades Bot to a Bot-y Guard. When Tom breaks in and sets off Bot's defensive systems, things get out of control and Bot terrorizes the whole lab crew. Jerry and Napoleon must figure out how to disarm Bot without hurting him.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (42)
programme.desc: When the witches' herb garden is destroyed, Tom sets a trap to capture the pest responsible. Quackers helps him but is unknowingly the pest Tom seeks to capture.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (76)
programme.desc: To finally be on an equal footing with Grizzy's imposing build and throw their own weight around in the cabin, the Lemmings decide to wear a blow-up sumotori costume.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (77)
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings discover an ancient Amerindian table with the power to show you past events. They relive their prehistoric ancestors' first confrontations, and learn that chocolate spread was invented long, long ago.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (78)
programme.desc: The Lemmings discover an old book of magic spells with a formula that enables one to take on the appearance of any other creature. The Lemmings have the bright idea of transforming one their kin into a double of the she-bear Grizzy is madly in love with in order to trick him. How could Grizzy refuse to give his jar of chocolate spread to his sweetheart?

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers (23)
programme.desc: Deep in the jungle, chaos erupts when a pair of raptors ambush the kids. But before the predators can strike, Uncle Jack and Pa swoop in, tackling the dinos with daring moves and perfect timing! As the brothers trade grins and playful jabs, it’s clear this isn’t just teamwork, it’s a competition! This kickstarts the ultimate race, as the brothers compete to get to the top of the volcano first.

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers (24)
programme.desc: It’s Ma and Pa’s last day on Dino Island, and the Ranchers are determined to make it perfect! So, they each pick one big adventure—three epic Cassidy-style activities to send their parents off in unforgettable fashion! However, each activity ends in ultimate failure and the kids are disappointed- until they are reminded by their parents that any day spent together is the perfect day.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (12)
programme.desc: Mr Bean and Teddy are looking forward to seeing a once-in-a-lifetime comet - but it won’t appear until 4am! He tries to stay up, but it’s useless - he keeps dropping off. So instead, Mr Bean decides to go to bed and set an alarm - yet he over-winds the clock and it breaks! With all the shops closed, his only option is to build his own complicated version to make sure he doesn’t miss the comet…

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (13)
programme.desc: Mrs Wicket makes Mr Bean drive her to the hospital to get her ingrown toenail seen to and asks him to wait. Mr Bean gets bored, and on a wander around the hospital he finds a spare doctor’s outfit with stethoscope - great Teddy - I’ll give you a check-up! But a nurse spots him, and thinking he’s a new doctor Mr Bean is asked to visit patients. How long can he keep it up before he’s found out?

programme.title: Baby Lemmings (12)
programme.desc: The Baby Lemmings discover that blowing into a leaf makes sounds that light up and even make fireflies dance! Meanwhile, the cowardly and tired Baby Moose is looking for a place to sleep. But as soon as the moon gets hidden, his fear of the dark makes him tremble and prevents him from getting any sleep. When he spots the Baby Lemmings' fireflies, he decides to capture them to make a nightlight.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings (13)
programme.desc: The Baby Lemmings accidentally discover how to make syrup flow from the trunk of a maple tree. It's a strangely sticky substance that can be used to invent all kinds of games! Their neighbour, Baby Raccoon, who is a real stickler for cleanliness, thinks they should get rid of the stuff, which collects leaves and dust and sticks everywhere, otherwise the forest and its lair will never be spotless!

programme.title: Baby Lemmings (14)
programme.desc: Seeing a line of ants carrying leaves and flowers gives a group of baby lemmings the idea of doing a choreography to imitate them. Seeing that their baby lemming friends like it, they decide to put on a little show. Baby Lynx discovers this and, a little jealous, decides to crash the show and put herself forward. Clumsily, she unwittingly puts an end to the show.

programme.title: Batwheels (13)
programme.desc: When Batman teams up with Aquaman to stop a sinister undersea plot, the Batwheels are excited to use their new cool underwater mode!

programme.title: Batwheels (37)
programme.desc: When Redbird tries his hand at espionage as “V-8, the Super-Spy”, he quickly realizes he's gotten in over his head, so Redbird teams up with Bibi to save the Amusement Mile from Dr. Spy!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (27)
programme.desc: Fed up of driving Mrs Wicket everywhere, Mr Bean decides to teach her how to drive. He sets up a practice “car” in his flat using tin cans as pedals and household objects for all the levers. Mrs Wicket does so well that Mr Bean lets her have a proper lesson in his beloved car - but Mrs Wicket gets carried away in the real car, and it’s a white-knuckle ride!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (28)
programme.desc: Mr Bean wants to take a photo of a rare bird, the Rosy Starling, hoping to win a cash prize from a nature magazine. But the special nuts he’s bought to lure the bird have instead attracted a couple of persistent squirrels, who keep hopping onto the bird table he’s installed and helping themselves to the tasty nuts. It’s Bean vs squirrels, or so he thinks…

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (18)
programme.desc: Bean wants to avoid lunch with Irma’s Mum at all costs. He persuades Mrs. Wicket to let him join her on a coach trip to a concert - but he has to disguise himself as an old-aged pensioner or he won’t be allowed on the coach. Once on the coach Bean drives everyone mad with his anti-boredom antics.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (36)
programme.desc: Mr. Bean’s Birthday dinner gets off on the wrong foot when he and Teddy are made to take the worst table at a swanky restaurant. The evening is further ruined by a self-obsessed movie star at the next table. After a swim in the lobster tank, Mr. Bean unwittingly cooks up sweet revenge in the kitchen.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (46)
programme.desc: Irma calls Mr Bean to remind him about the Opera they are attending that night, but of course he has forgotten to buy tickets! He rushes to the box office, but they are sold out. So he hatches a plan to intercept the singer, Signor Parmigiano, at the train station and trick him into playing in his back garden - a private performance for just him and Irma!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (19)
programme.desc: Bean is showing Irma his favourite tree in the park one day when he discovers a tree surgeon getting ready to cut it down. He darts up the tree and won’t come back down. Irma loves this new side of Bean-ey! The tree surgeon is frustrated and tries various ploys to get Bean down. But can Bean make it to the toilet without being discovered and still save that tree?

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! (15)
programme.desc: When a rich man writes Scooby into his will, the gang must spend a night in his creepy mansion with kooky relatives and a spooky phantom to collect Scooby's share.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! (16)
programme.desc: Shaggy and Scooby discover their new favorite food as the gang investigates the mystery of a frightening Sorcerer that's haunting a snack factory!

programme.title: Lamput (43)
programme.desc: Specs and Skinny celebrate a brand new arrival to the family: a body lotion that delivers incredible speed to its wearer. Yay Science! The boys quickly include the speed lotion in their morning routine, because testing inventions on yourself is always a good idea. Then it's time to get out there and nab Lamput once and for all. Results are mixed. On the one hand, the "zoom oil" certainly works. On the other hand, these nerds aren't really used to having a body that can actually do things.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (67)
programme.desc: While looking for the TV remote-control device, Grizzy happens onto a box that can localize a bunch of keys thanks to its key ring, which is equipped with a tracker. Grizzy decides to stick the spy device under a jar of chocolate spread, just in case the Lemmings should decide to carry it off.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (68)
programme.desc: While looking for the TV remote-control device, Grizzy happens onto a box that can localize a bunch of keys thanks to its key ring, which is equipped with a tracker. Grizzy decides to stick the spy device under a jar of chocolate spread, just in case the Lemmings should decide to carry it off.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (69)
programme.desc: The Lemmings create a customized hang-glider using a supermarket shopping cart for the nacelle and a ventilator as an engine. Their aerobatics fascinate the she-bear that Grizzy is in love with, which gives him the idea of replacing the shopping cart with a double-seat and inviting his beloved for a sky promenade. But confiscating a wing in mid-flight is not within the reach of just any old bear.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (70)
programme.desc: In this fairy episode, due to a strike on the head and seeing the fairy story book pictures, the Lemmings believe they are the dwarves from the tale Snow White, and start attacking the cabin with pickaxes. After that Grizzy also believes he is Snow White due to same incidence.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (71)
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings' favorite chocolate spread brand is organizing a big competition where the prize is a giant jar of spread. To win, one must make ten baskets in a row in a hoop set up on a supermarket parking lot for the occasion. Ready to play?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (72)
programme.desc: After being frozen for millions of years, a saber-toothed bear bursts into the cabin looking for food.

programme.title: Tom and Jerry Gokko (4)
programme.desc: Tom is enjoying his bath time while Jerry bathes Tuffy. Tuffy ends up floating off in a bubble and lands in Tom's bath. Jerry throws in all of the bath bombs creating a massive amount of bubbles. In the end, they all work together to get clean.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (8)
programme.desc: Mr Bean is very scared on a stormy night and even more so when he hears Mrs Wicket screaming from downstairs. Mr Bean investigates and finds the source of the problem...a rat! Mr Bean offers to help Mrs Wicket rid their house of the troublesome rodent. The only problem is the crafty rat is going nowhere fast and is always one step ahead. Mr Bean looks to inspiration from the Pied Piper but fairy stories don’t always have happy endings.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (43)
programme.desc: When Mr. Bean's picnic sandwiches get eaten by pigeons, he heads to the supermarket to replace them. Only the parent and child parking bays are free, so he parks there and pretends that Teddy is a baby in a blanket, plonking him in a trolley. But once in the shop, he gets the trollies mixed up and ends up with a real baby! Can he switch the baby and Teddy back before he's found out?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (9)
programme.desc: Mr Bean decides to do something romantic on Valentine’s Day for his long-suffering girlfriend Irma. But while he is secretly delivering her valentines card Mr Bean finds out he has a love rival for Irma’s attention. Bean steps up his efforts and takes Irma on a ‘date’ to the Valentine’s Fair only to find his love rival is there too! But will the fortune-teller’s prediction be the ticket to a happy ending?

He dashes to the supermarket to buy some groceries but why buy food when you can win an entire trolley full in an All You Can Eat Competition? But Mr Bean has some stiff competition - no one can eat one of Mr Magg’s pies quicker than Mr Maggs himself. Mr Bean has to think fast to win. But after all that eating will Bean still be in the mood to cook a romantic meal?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (11)
programme.desc: Mr Bean is in need of a sturdy new bookcase and sets off to visit a furniture warehouse. He finds one that’s perfect but is outraged when he’s told he has to build the bookcase himself! Bean is unfamiliar with flat pack assembly and struggles to construct his new bookcase failing miserably when he discovers he’s one screw short. Mr Bean heads back to the shop only to find it’s closed!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (1)
programme.desc: Inspired by a wildlife documentary on TV, Mr. Bean dusts off his camera and treks deep into the countryside in search of the perfect wildlife photograph. After two fruitless days of being the hunter, he is somewhat miffed to find himself the hunted.

programme.title: Batwheels (12)
programme.desc: The Batwheels are shocked to discover that a crime wave taking place in Gotham is being perpetrated by someone very familiar...

programme.title: Batwheels (28)
programme.desc: Bibi wishes she could live a rule-free life like Jestah, so she decides to only focus on having fun instead. But when her actions put Batgirl in danger, Bibi must put the fun aside to stop Harley and save her hero.

programme.title: Meet the Batwheels (17)
programme.desc: Batwing flies high over Gotham in her video diary as she shares exciting tips and tricks to what makes her brand of crimefighting so special!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (52)
programme.desc: The Lemmings inherit a crate that fell off a Canadian army convoy transporting ultra-secret material. The case inside the crate emits a sort of laser beam that divides objects into multiple miniaturized versions of themselves. What if the Lemmings had to deal with lots of mini-Grizzys rather than just one big one?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (53)
programme.desc: Near the supermarket, a machine hands out surprise eggs in exchange for a coin. Amongst the lots to be won, there is a super firework rocket that makes the Lemmings dream, and a piece of costume jewelry that Grizzy imagines himself giving to his lady-love.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (54)
programme.desc: At the Ranger's home, Grizzy finds a high-tech gadget that enables you to learn anything at all sewing, origami, Kung Fu, etc... within only seconds thank to electrodes hooked to the brain. He can now become the perfect bear! But first, he first needs a program to learn how to get rid of the Lemmings.

programme.title: Lamput (42)
programme.desc: It's back to basics as Specs attempts to catch Lamput with a net. Not being much good at anything at all physical, Specs ends up whacking himself on his own noggin. The blow shakes loose what little ability Specs had to function as an adult. He's transformed into a wailing infant who requires 24 hour care from his devoted... parents? Skinny and Lamput have to learn on the job. Taking care of a baby is hard. Especially if it's a giant annoying one.

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers (25)
programme.desc: The Ranchers are herding a massive pack of pachycephalosaurs! The stubborn herd keeps scattering in every direction! High above, Miguel spots danger ahead, a tiny psittacosaurus right in the herd’s path! Miguel swoops down and plucks the little dino out of harm’s way, but the pint-sized creature unleashes a squawk so loud it rattles the trees, sending the baby dino tumbling into the jungle below!

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers (26)
programme.desc: During an underwater patrol, the Ranchers spot Shelly, their young sea turtle friend. But Shelly urges the team to follow her into the depths, straight to a weakened Mama Turtle! Min quickly diagnoses the problem: shell shingles!t Uncle Jack delivers bad news, they’re short on Blue Sea Kelp, the only remedy! Jon and Miguel, ever the eager “bro-moms,” volunteer to go fetch it!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (5)
programme.desc: Mr Bean is watching Clint Chiseljaw - his favourite action TV show - with Billy, but Mrs Wicket orders her nephew downstairs to finish his chores. Inspired by Clint’s catchphrase - “Nobody gets left behind”, Mr Bean tries a variety of different daring plans to break Billy out of Mrs Wicket’s flat. But none of them work, until he hits on the perfect plan… or so he thinks!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (6)
programme.desc: Mr Bean peers through the window of the opening party of an art exhibition and sees free snacks being handed around - yum! But he’s told by the bouncer that he needs to be smartly dressed. So he sneaks into the artist’s studio and paints a tuxedo onto himself. This time he’s let in, but will Bean’s fake painted suit last long enough for him to get his free food?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (46)
programme.desc: Irma calls Mr Bean to remind him about the Opera they are attending that night, but of course he has forgotten to buy tickets! He rushes to the box office, but they are sold out. So he hatches a plan to intercept the singer, Signor Parmigiano, at the train station and trick him into playing in his back garden - a private performance for just him and Irma!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (5)
programme.desc: There’s easy money to be had in the art world and Mr. Bean is set on getting some of it. Once equipped with the right tools, he ventures into the countryside with a blank canvas in search of inspiration - and comes home with a painting full of life. Literally.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings (11)
programme.desc: The Baby Lemmings knock down one of Baby Beaver's constructions, bowling style. He immediately gets angry and sends the lemmings off to play further away. But he soon runs out of branches for his construction. While he is looking for new ones, he notices that the Baby Lemmings have collected all the beautiful branches in the area to build a natural bowling alley! Baby beaver wants to take their branches, but the Baby Lemmings won't let him!

Slovenská pohádka

programme.title: Sníček (12)
programme.desc: Hugo splní dětem každý sen! V noci snové víly přinášejí dětem sny. Ale co dělají přes den? Hugo se nudí, a tak si usmyslí, že Lucii a Damiána bude navštěvovat i během dne. Jelikož se však neumí v našem světě chovat, děti ho musí učit základy slušné výchovy. On jim za to vysvětlí, jak fungují nejznámější hodiny na světě Big Ben, a ukáže, jak žijí různá zvířata. Vezme je do džungle, pod mořskou hladinu, do vesmíru, a také do svého snového světa, kde je možné opravdu všechno.

programme.title: Zabij nudu! II
programme.desc: Dochází vám fantazie, co dělat doma s dětmi? Je tu pořad, v němž dostanete návod, jak spolu smysluplně prožít společně strávený čas. A také jak vyrobit jedinečné věci, které oživí vaši domácnost. Zažijete přitom určitě spoustu zábavy! Jsou to věci funkční, dekorační nebo jen pro zábavu, například pomůcky do školy, pokladničky či žertovné ozdoby. Slovenský tvůrčí pořad

programme.title: Staré pověsti české (1)
programme.desc: Animované Staré pověsti české vznikly ve vlastní produkci televizí CS Film a CS Mini. Producenti televize hledali velký příběh, který by připomínal tradice a naši minulost. Jan Werich o Jiráskovi, podle jehož námětu byl seriál natočen, řekl: „Kdyby Jirásek žil v Hollywoodu, byl by milionář, protože měl výborné zápletky.“ Oslavoval český národ, ale ne na úkor jiných. Tu a tam zušlechťoval naši historii a prokládal ji sentimentálními příběhy, a tak nám ji přibližoval a činil bližší.

programme.title: Bílý tesák (3)
programme.desc: Klasické dílo světové dobrodružné literatury Bílý tesák od Jacka Londona ožívá ve dvanáctidílném seriálu, který je vytvořen originální animační technikou. Živá kresba zachycuje na pozadí nehostinné Aljašky v době vrcholící zlaté horečky osud psa, v jehož žilách koluje vlčí krev. Český animovaný seriál

programme.title: Příběhy kocoura Modroočka (2)
programme.desc: Modroočko má jemný kožíšek, velikánské modré oči, dlouhé vlasy a hebký čumáček. Je to vzdělaný kocourek, který si píše deník a bydlí u svého pána, spisovatele. Objevuje svět kolem sebe a vypráví o všech svých dvounohých a čtyřnohých přátelích. Z díry v plotu ho zachrání nový přítel - kocour Bělovous, na dovolené získá další přátele - ježka Šramotu, loveckého psa Fouska a králíka Bílé Pírko. Také se seznámí s kočičkou Kiki a popere se kvůli ní s obrovským zlomyslným kocourem Žluťákem.

programme.title: Žofka a její dobrodružství (12)
programme.desc: Veselé příběhy podnikavé opičky Žofky Orangutanové a jejích zvířecích kamarádů v zoologické zahradě. Československý animovaný seriál .

programme.title: Broučci (2)
programme.desc: Animovaný loutkový seriál na motivy knihy Jana Karafiáta. Karafiátova kniha s ilustracemi Jiřího Trnky inspirovala už celou řadu adaptací a stále patří do zlatého fondu české dětské literatury. Tato filmová verze Broučků citlivě pracuje se známými hodnotami a snaží se je co nejvíce přiblížit dnešním dětem. Český animovaný loutkový seriál

programme.title: Tisíc a jedna noc (1)
programme.desc: Animovaný seriál, jehož jednotlivé části vyprávějí příhody ze známé knihy Pohádky tisíce a jedné noci. Český animovaný seriál

programme.title: O Dorotce (4)
programme.desc: Holčička Dorotka a její věrný kamarád papoušek Koko spolu prožívají různá veselá dobrodružství. Československý animovaný seriál

programme.title: Já Baryk (4)
programme.desc: Dvanáct příběhů, z nichž každý je věnovaný vždy jednomu měsíci v roce a jednomu zvířeti, se kterým se dobromyslný pes Baryk ve svém okolí potká, to je spousta veselých i napínavých příhod.

programme.title: Mach a Šebestová (3)
programme.desc: Jednou vyprávěla třídní učitelka o době ledové a člověku neandrtálském, který lovil mamuty a jedl je k obědu a k večeři. To velmi zaujalo Šebestovou a začala se ptát, jak toho mamuta jedli. S brusinkami jako zajíce, nebo s bramborovým salátem? Třídní učitelka na to: "Poslouchej Šebestová: člověka neandrtálského ještě nikdo neviděl, to neví ani soudruh ředitel, jak to mám vědět já." Když šli Mach se Šebestovou ze školy, tak je napadlo, že zavolají do sluchátka a přenesou se do doby ledové.

programme.title: Krakonošovy pohádky (7)
programme.desc: Před mnoha a mnoha lety, kdy lesy byly plné zvěře a ptactva, vládl horám u pramenů Labe Krakonoš. Na jeho kraj bylo utěšené podívání, ale o živobytí se v něm musel každý s přírodou poprat... Východoněmecko-československý animovaný loutkový seriál

programme.title: Katapult
programme.desc: Neslavná cesta úniku z každodenního ubíjejícího života. Inženýr Jošt bojuje proti stereotypu rodinného života a rozhodne se žít současně několik životů s několika ženami. Černá komedie podle románu Vladimíra Párala. Třiatřicetiletý inženýr Jacek Jošt má hezkou ženu a malou dcerku. Pomalu se užírá stereotypním manželským životem. Nikterak vzrušující práce kontrolora a rodina, kde se denně opakují stále stejné scény. Proto chce začarovaný kruh protrhnout za každou cenu.

programme.title: Siréna
programme.desc: Legenda o kladenských hornících a revolučních událostech pohnutého roku 1889. Filmové drama podle stejnojmenného románu Marie Majerové o spravedlivém boji horníků za jejich práva. Román Marie Majerové i jeho filmové zpracování je inspirováno skutečnými událostmi, které se odehrály na Kladně v roce 1889. Sugestivní sociální drama zachycuje události spjaté se vzpourou horníků na Kladensku proti majiteli dolů Becherovi v den Božího těla roku 1889.

programme.title: Jiří Suchý - Život s divadlem Semafor
programme.desc: Na základě rozhovoru z roku 2012 vznikl dokumentární film o významném členovi české umělecké scény Jiřím Suchém. Proslavil se zejména jako autor mnoha divadelních her, jako vynikající textař a zpěvák, jako herec, režisér, malíř a šéf populárního divadla Semafor. Dokument mapuje jeho tvorbu, představuje jeho díla a dobu, ve kterých vznikala. Zabývá se ale i úvahami o budoucnosti a dalších životních plánech a samozřejmě nechybí oblíbené písničky z divadla Semafor. Český dokumentární film

programme.title: Filmové minuty
programme.desc: Filmové minuty přinášejí souhrnné filmové zpravodajství ze světa filmu, aktuality, ocenění, výročí, nové a připravované projekty a mnoho dalšího z domova i ze zahraničí... Filmová publicistika

programme.title: Milenci a vrazi
programme.desc: Vraždí, protože milují. Milují, až by vraždili. Hořký obraz lidské touhy po požitcích, moci a majetku podle stejnojmenného románu Vladimíra Párala. V přízemí domu kdesi v Ústí nad Labem nedaleko chemičky je "montércimra", kde se střídají obyvatelé náhodní i trvalí, nad ní je byt ředitele továrny a pak část pokojů ženských a mužských - svobodárna. Nikdy ale toto uspořádání není dodrženo. Všechno je tu beznadějně pomícháno, do svobodárny vnikne mladý pár, čekající dítě.

programme.title: Velká přehrada
programme.desc: Mladý inženýr si zařídil vlastní projekční kancelář a zadal svůj projekt do soutěže na velkou vodní stavbu. Jeho představy o poctivé a odpovědné práci narazí na spekulace bezcharakterního velkopodnikatele. Mladý inženýr Petr Pavelec pracuje na plánu přehrady na řece Loučnici. Seznámí se s dcerou nesvědomitého stavebního podnikatele Berky, Irenou, a zamiluje se do ní. Když Petrův projekt vyhraje konkurz, Berka s Irenou ho získají jako společníka, a tak je firmě zadána stavba přehrady.

programme.title: Žalář nejtemnější
programme.desc: Luděk Munzar v dramatickém příběhu o zaslepené žárlivosti podle stejnojmenného románu Ivana Olbrachta. Sebevědomý mladý venkovský úředník komisař Mach, který má krásnou ženu, po náhodném zranění oslepne. Se ženou se odstěhuje do Prahy. Ve své slepotě, kterou se snaží fyzicky překonat, je mučen žárlivostí a podezřívavostí. Slepota se stala katalyzátorem jeho vrozené žárlivosti, která nyní přerůstá v nesnesitelnost. Je přesvědčen, že ho všichni podvádějí, především jeho krásná žena.

programme.title: Čechoslovák, režisér Julius Matula
programme.desc: Režisér Julius Matula (*1943) se sice narodil na Slovensku, avšak celou svou filmovou tvorbou je spojen s českým prostředím. Občas se zaměřoval na partnerské vztahy mezi českými a slovenskými partnery, avšak převažovala společenská dramata o složitém vytváření ideologicky žádoucích životních postojů. Čerpal i ze zkušeností se sportem, jemuž se v mládí aktivně věnoval. Jeho tvůrčí dráha (Řeknem si to příští léto, Hauři, Kariéra, Bloudění orientačního běžce) zahrnuje 70. a 80.

programme.title: Příště budeme chytřejší, staroušku!
programme.desc: Satirická komedie o dvou podvodníčcích pronásledovaných věčnou smůlou. Komedie o dvou nepoučitelných smolařích, kteří při svých rafinovaných podvodech vždy narazí na podvodníky ještě většího kalibru. Recidivisté Karel Vašátko a Gustav Makovec stále ještě nepřišli na to, jak přijít k nepoctivým penězům beztrestně, a tak znovu končí za mřížemi. Gustav Makovec a Karel Vašátko jsou dva nerozluční kamarádi a podvodníci, kteří nedokážou odolat vidině snadného zisku.

programme.title: Utopená ponorka
programme.desc: Plošková sarkastická parodie na komiksové seriály z třicátých let nedávno minulého století. Československý animovaný film

programme.title: Kinosál
programme.desc: V pořadu o nových filmech v kinech každý týden informujeme o nejzajímavějších a nejočekávanějších titulech v naší distribuci. V krátkých reportážích se zaměříme na zákulisí vzniku filmů, kuriozity z natáčení a výpovědi tvůrců. Přineseme rozhovory s českými a slovenskými filmaři, kteří v našich končinách stále více natáčejí své autorské projekty, a zachytíme jejich tvůrčí atmosféru. Filmová publicistika

programme.title: Valentin Dobrotivý
programme.desc: Komedie o kanadském žertíku, který mohl přijít hodně draho. Velmi pracovitý, ale také velmi naivní úředník pojišťovny Valentin Plavec se stává terčem nekonečných legrácek, vtípků a recesí svých kolegů Bejšovce a Voborníka. Poslední vydařený kousek se jim však poněkud vymkl z ruky. Připsali totiž k výhernímu číslu 8456 jedničku a namluvili Valentinovi, že vyhrál v loterii milion.

programme.desc: Uznávaná kolumbijská zpěvačka po vydání cenou Grammy oceněného alba „El Dorado“ vyrazila v roce 2018 na turné nejen s aktuální tvorbou, ale i prověřenými hity

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (1)
programme.desc: Mr Bean and Teddy have no plans, so decide to stay in bed all day. Mr Bean is determined that his feet can’t touch the ground, so he pushes the bed around with a broom. He has to find ingenious ways to make his tea and toast for breakfast, brush his teeth and an even bigger challenge of ordering a pizza and collecting it from downstairs without getting out of bed!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (2)
programme.desc: After seeing the flashy electric go-kart Mr Paliwal has bought for his daughter Divya, Mr Bean and Billy build their own using items around Mrs Wicket’s garden. At the go-kart track, Mr Bean and Mr Paliwal are unimpressed with Billy and Divya’s driving skills so take the karts for a “proper” race around the park. Meanwhile Mrs Wicket is on the warpath when she finds things missing from her house.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (77)
programme.desc: The Lemmings play a game of Murder Mystery where a detective must lead an enquiry to resolve a falsemurder. Meanwhile, Grizzy prepares a meal with a sample of Yummy but when his back is turned his sample is mysteriously crushed! Grizzy immediately accuses the Lemmings, who can prove they were playing at the time of the “crime.” Grizzy is distraught but the Lemmings are well determined to lead their own enquiry and unmask the true “assassin” of the Yummy sample.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (78)
programme.desc: The Lemmings find a talisman that makes inanimate objects come to life. When the talisman lands atop thecabin, Grizzy and the Lemmings realize how many misadventures the cabin has suffered from on theirtravels since they left Canada. The now “living” cabin has only one objective: return to Canada, withoutGrizzy or the Lemmings.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (1)
programme.desc: Nutty Hill is suffering from a stifling heat wave. Searching in vain for a bit of cool air, Grizzy suddenly has a brilliant idea. He'll get into the fridge, where the temperature will be more bearable. One slight detail, the refrigerator shelves are already full of Lemmings.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (2)
programme.desc: Grizzy is frustrated: just as he was about to coat a nice big fresh salmon with chocolate spread and snuggle up in front of the TV, he discovers that the pantry is empty! His frustration transforms into rage when he finds the last jar in the clutches of the Lemmings, who are organizing a sort of "beach party" in the sandbox.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (3)
programme.desc: Grizzy's nap is interrupted by an annoying vibrating. He sees the forest ranger's cell phone on the couch. It has various functions, including a game to which he instantly becomes addicted. However the Lemmings, who have already detected the phone's music app, need it in order to transform the garage into a discotheque.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (4)
programme.desc: Freed by the thawing ice, a mysterious giant egg slides up to the front door of the log cabin. The Lemmings watch the hatching of a large baby dinosaur that immediately mistakes them for his "mommies." Grizzy cannot tolerate a new intruder like this in the cabin, but how does one earn the respect of a gang of Lemmings armed with a T-Rex, even it is only a baby?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (5)
programme.desc: In order to seduce the she-bear he's infatuated with, Grizzy decides to take things in hand and slim down with the ranger's bodybuilding equipment. But before starting his exercise routine, he will first have to settle the problem of the Lemmings, who are already using the machines as an amusement park.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (6)
programme.desc: By chance, Grizzy discovers that the ranger's new robot vacuum cleaner also gives very pleasant back massages. But the Lemmings see the new gadget more as a competition bumper car. No one wants to do the housecleaning, but everyone wants the robot vacuum cleaner!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (7)
programme.desc: While searching for the television remote control, Grizzy discovers a gadget that controls various functions in the cabin. Hup! One button and there's light! Hup! Another surveys the house's nooks and crannies. Grizzy will finally be able to rid himself of the Lemmings, without even leaving the couch! But beware of losing control...

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (8)
programme.desc: To make sure that the Lemmings don't snatch his chocolate spread while he's taking his nap, Grizzy turns the fridge into a safe - combination lock and all. The Lemmings try in vain to break into the fridge until they see Grizzy open the door while sleepwalking. Unfortunately, Grizzy wakes up at the crucial moment. The Lemmings do everything possible to make him fall back asleep as quick as possible.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (9)
programme.desc: The Lemmings have invented a new popcorn game which consists of throwing popcorn and catching it with their mouths. Grizzy notices that his lovely she-bear seems to be drawn by the scent of the grilled corn and decides to invite her over for a snack, just the two of them. But first, he must quickly recover the popcorn from the Lemmings.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (10)
programme.desc: Grizzy wants to learn to dance the mambo to please the she-bear he's in love with, for she truly adores this rhythm. He finds a learning kit at the ranger's home which has a dance carpet with footprints that light up in rhythm. The only problem is that Lemmings want the ghetto-blaster to continue their rave party to an entirely different beat.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (11)
programme.desc: After receiving a terrible blow over the head, Grizzy is no longer the same: he thinks he's a rodent! He tries to get the gang to adopt him so that he might participate in their fun and games like any other Lemming. But it's not long before his newfound comrades start to find him rather heavy!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (12)
programme.desc: Grizzy is exhausted and the couch has never seemed so enticing! He goes to fetch a pillow and a sleeping mask, but the Lemmings have entirely different plans for the couch. They see it as a fabulous trampoline and the ideal spot for an aerobics session. To win the right to have his nap, the weary bear must first contend with the super-energetic Lemmings!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (13)
programme.desc: Grizzy discovers that the frenzied "break dance" the Lemmings are doing is actually due to the fleas they are infested with. When Grizzy catches them too, it's panic all round! Grizzy is determined to eliminate the parasites, down to the very last one. The problem is his little roommates have no desire whatsoever to be treated...

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (52)
programme.desc: When Mr Bean forgets Irma’s birthday, he asks Divya to help him build a snow sculpture in her likeness. It looks great, but the sun comes out and the sculpture starts to melt. Mr Bean decides to take it into his flat to protect it from the sun - but even that isn’t working. Will he be able to keep it frozen until Irma arrives?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (1)

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (3)
programme.desc: Mr Bean and Teddy head to the bowling alley with a free voucher, but Mr Bean finds it a lot harder than he expected. Seeing a little girl with a smaller ball, he borrows it, thinking it will be easier to use. But instead, he gets his fingers stuck in the ball and he causes havoc trying to pull them out.

programme.title: Lamput (36)
programme.desc: The Docs are so obsessed with catching Lamput that even in their dreams, the chase goes on. It’s really not a restful sleep, when you keep waking up sweating from horrid visions that, let’s face it, just remind you what a nightmare your day job is. The Docs make the brave decision to see a therapist about these terrible dreams. In the waiting room is the last orange blob they wanted to see; apparently a life of hot pursuit is taking its toll on Lamput, too.

programme.title: Moley (9)
programme.desc: When an egg rolls into Moletown and a duckling hatches, Moley must play momma to the baby duck until they can find its home.

programme.title: Moley (10)
programme.desc: When Moley helps take care of the worms at Dotty’s Adopt a Worm Rescue Center, the Gardener sends Squirm to pose as a homeless worm and help him steal Manny.

programme.title: Moley (11)
programme.desc: Moley vows to not eat worms for a few days in support of Dotty’s veganism and his worm craving temptations get out of control.

programme.title: Moley (12)
programme.desc: When Moley spends the day with a young mole named Cheese who wants to be just like him, Moley helps Cheese recognize his own talents and uniqueness.

programme.title: Moley (13)
programme.desc: Mishmosh builds a tunnel digger, upsetting some that it will replace moles’ need to dig themselves. Dotty accidently gets locked in the machine and it gets activated!

programme.title: Meet the Batwheels (22)
programme.desc: A musical tribute to Ace, the super-brave bat-hound!

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables (7)
programme.desc: Chep is over-joyed when his weevil friend, Chase, returns to Mushton. But Chase seems to have changed, he's way harder to handle now. And he wants something from Chep! But what?

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables (8)
programme.desc: Chep has to give the Mushlets a talk about spiders. But talking in front of a group makes Chep nervous. Mush-Mush offers to do it instead. Problem is Mush-Mush’s knowledge of spiders is so bad he ends up getting caught by one!

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables (9)
programme.desc: The Mushlers want Amanita to join in telling monster stories. But Amanita doesn’t believe in monsters. So they take her on a monster hunt and find more than they imagined.

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables (10)
programme.desc: Chep wants to be brave enough to join in the daring games that Mush-Mush and Lilit like to play. So he gets some protective moss pants that make him not only indestructible but also fashionable… and a bit cocky. Woo, it’s the new Chep!

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables (11)
programme.desc: Mush-Mush really wants to get over his fear of snakes. Truff really wants to get over his fear of ants. So they team up to help each other overcome their fears… maybe.

programme.title: SuperThings: Rivals of Kaboom - Kazoom Power (34)
programme.desc: A battle among Superthings throws the new Kazoom Kids into a surreal world where everything they draw and erase... comes to life!

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (43)
programme.desc: Rick's taken up painting to help him relax. Although he's warned them to stay out of his studio, Tom and Jerry inadvertently destroy his first painting. In an effort to reproduce it before he returns home, Tom and Jerry end up in a competition to prove who's the better artist. May the best Renoir win!

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (44)
programme.desc: Unable to sleep because of the incessant barking from a dog somewhere in the city, Tom and Jerry must track down the noisy mutt. When they find the dog with the help of a friendly bat, they discover the pup can't sleep without her special pillow. Now, for the sake of everyone's sleep, the great pillow case is on!

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (43)
programme.desc: When Tom and Jerry accidentally lose Ginger's wedding ring down the drain, they send Jerry down the pipes to retrieve it, but it leads down the drain, to the sewers and out to the beach! The pets must keep Rick and Ginger from using the water until everything is back in order.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (44)
programme.desc: Dr. Bigby creates an amazing helmet that accidentally turns Tom into a genius. Napoleon, Jerry and Hamster all work together to take down the newly smart Tom who is now building a mouse-destroying weapon.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (1)
programme.desc: When Grizzy propels the Lemmings out of the log cabin perched on the Great Wall of China, the critters land on a small traditional house in a bamboo forest where they discover a box filled with fortune cookies. One Lemming gets super lucky after eating one. Armed with their magic cookies, the Lemmings set out to confront Grizzy. But each cookie represents a power… or a curse!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (2)
programme.desc: The Lemmings love sesame nougat but Grizzy, who adores this treat too, steals their box. Quite upset, the rodents search for more, in vain. Instead, they discover the art of energy points in an old Chinese medicine book. Determined to recover their sweets regardless of the cost, the Lemmings activate Grizzy's vital points and the bear finds himself completely blocked. Thanks to the book, Grizzy frees himself and learns to master energies in turn.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (3)
programme.desc: After a game that ends abruptly, the Lemmings fall onto the roof of a temple where they discover drawings of Tai Chi movements. When carried out, the exercises generate a ball of energy! The Lemmings test out the sequence of movements on… Grizzy, until he is evicted from the cabin and falls onto the temple in turn. His fall unveils a new sequence of movements on a fresco that could create an even stronger energy flow!

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers (25)
programme.desc: The Ranchers are herding a massive pack of pachycephalosaurs! The stubborn herd keeps scattering in every direction! High above, Miguel spots danger ahead, a tiny psittacosaurus right in the herd’s path! Miguel swoops down and plucks the little dino out of harm’s way, but the pint-sized creature unleashes a squawk so loud it rattles the trees, sending the baby dino tumbling into the jungle below!

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers (26)
programme.desc: During an underwater patrol, the Ranchers spot Shelly, their young sea turtle friend. But Shelly urges the team to follow her into the depths, straight to a weakened Mama Turtle! Min quickly diagnoses the problem: shell shingles!t Uncle Jack delivers bad news, they’re short on Blue Sea Kelp, the only remedy! Jon and Miguel, ever the eager “bro-moms,” volunteer to go fetch it!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (14)
programme.desc: Mr Bean is at the supermarket when he spots a cool fire engine ride - but the security guard makes it clear it’s for little kids only. Not to be deterred, Mr Bean tries everything he can to distract the guard to have his go on the ride. When he finally does get his go, it’s not as good as he thought it would be, especially when a real fire engine has to be called to help Mr Bean!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (15)
programme.desc: Mr Bean receives a delivery of a bunch of flowers for Mrs Wicket, but accidentally runs them over in the his car. He can’t afford to replace them, so he decides to recreate the bunch by taking flowers one by one from anywhere he can - a vase in a café, a wedding bouquet, even from between the teeth of a tango dancer! But will he assemble the bunch and be back in time for Mrs Wicket?

programme.title: Baby Lemmings (15)
programme.desc: Baby lemmings discover a fun new game: running on logs! While playing, the Baby lemmings find themselves racing Baby Lynx without realizing it. To the horror of Baby Lynx, who hates defeat, she loses the race! The Baby Lemmings with their logs are faster than Baby Lynx. Her pride stung, she decides to steal the vehicle that allows her to be faster.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings (16)
programme.desc: Baby Raccoon notices that the forest floor is covered in leaves... No way! It's too dirty for him. He decides to rake them up into nice, cubic heaps, not realizing that he's providing great cushions for the baby lemmings, who have fun throwing themselves into them making firework displays of colorful leaves! Faced with this rampage, Baby Raccoon decides to block the baby lemmings and resume his housework, but the little baby lemmings have more than one trick up their sleeve!

programme.title: Baby Lemmings (17)
programme.desc: It's a windy day in the Canadian forest, and Baby Lynx is having fun catching flying leaves like a little kitten. Meanwhile, the baby lemmings are discovering how to make kites out of leaves. When Baby Lynx sees them, she wants to catch them, and the baby lemmings have to be extra agile to dodge Baby Lynx's attacks.

programme.title: Batwheels (19)
programme.desc: Clayface is back in town, and this time he may be too much, and too many, for the Batwheels to handle!

programme.title: Batwheels (38)
programme.desc: Bibi has a terrible no-good day after she keeps messing up and lets Joker get away. She doesn’t think he can help Batgirl anymore, but a “bad today” doesn’t mean it’ll be a “bad tomorrow".

But just as he’s about to finish it, Scrapper sniffs out some nearby sandwiches and causes havoc. In the confusion, Mr Bean thinks the cat has swallowed the rudder of his toy boat, so has to capture him and take him to the vet. Will he get his rudder back in time for the race?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (30)

But when he sees that they are also showing an action movie - Zombie Aliens 3 - he finds a way to sneak out and into the other screen. But will he get past the usher, and what will happen when Irma notices?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (20)

Bean decides to hi-jack the sales process in order to deter all potential buyers - even if it means turning the whole house upside down!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (37)

Bloodhound that he is, he pursues the culprit across the Channel to Paris only to be waylaid by a Reliant Robin, a traffic jam, and a mime artist under the Eiffel Tower. Will Mr Bean ‘the International Art Sleuth’ prove successful?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (47)
programme.desc: Jealous of Mr Paliwal’s new egg-laying chicken, Mr Bean heads off to the local farm to get himself one. But after causing havoc at the coop, he comes home with the wrong chicken - not only will it not lay eggs, but it turns out Mrs Wicket is allergic to feathers so Mr Bean has to keep the chicken well hidden!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (21)
programme.desc: Mr. Bean wants to learn skateboarding but hurts himself on his first try. Meanwhile Miss Wince is showing off her new mobility scooter at Mrs. Wicket’s. Bean is entranced. He could do wicked ‘ollies’ with that! He absconds with a souped-up scooter and heads straight to the skate park ready to challenge Bruiser Senior and Junior …

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! (17)
programme.desc: The gang's trip to the bayou is ruined by a shambling Swamp Beast that's scaring away anyone who dares to enter its soggy domain!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! (18)
programme.desc: The gang hits the ski slopes, although Daphne's more focused on nailing Fred with a revenge snowball. Their snowy fun is soon interrupted by the appearance of an evil Snowman Monster eager to scare all trespassers off his mountain.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (73)
programme.desc: The Lemmings discover a top-secret Canadian Army prototype that allows you to pass through solid surfaces for a window of several seconds.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (74)
programme.desc: The Lemmings have found an Amerindian eagle amulet that endows he who wears it with the powers of a bird of prey. But to confiscate the magic totem from the Lemmings, who are now as sharp as eagles, Grizzy will have to use the cunning... of a puma.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (75)
programme.desc: The Lemmings are having a blast with the ranger's electric guitar and the cabin walls tremble with their experimental rock. Just as Grizzy is about to destroy the instrument, he realizes it can make harmonious sounds too. Will this be enough to seduce the she-bear he's in love with?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (76)
programme.desc: To finally be on an equal footing with Grizzy's imposing build and throw their own weight around in the cabin, the Lemmings decide to wear a blow-up sumotori costume.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (77)
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings discover an ancient Amerindian table with the power to show you past events. They relive their prehistoric ancestors' first confrontations, and learn that chocolate spread was invented long, long ago.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (78)
programme.desc: The Lemmings discover an old book of magic spells with a formula that enables one to take on the appearance of any other creature. The Lemmings have the bright idea of transforming one their kin into a double of the she-bear Grizzy is madly in love with in order to trick him. How could Grizzy refuse to give his jar of chocolate spread to his sweetheart?

programme.title: Tom and Jerry Gokko (5)
programme.desc: It’s the middle of the night and Tom plays makeshift instruments creating loud music that wakes up Jerry. Jerry tries to put an end to Tom's concert with no success. Tuffy wakes up and goes along with the music. Jerry decides to join in on the fun.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (12)

And her protective dad only wants the best for his ‘princess’. An on-going tussle ensues between Mr Bean the little girl and her Dad resulting in a chase across the seaside town and onto the pier. No one comes between Mr Bean Teddy and their ‘relaxing’ holiday!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (44)
programme.desc: Mrs Wicket gives Mr Bean some money for a hotel so that her Uncle Ron can stay in his flat, but Mr Bean decides to keep the money and hide in his wardrobe overnight. He makes himself comfortable among the clothes, but starts to get hungry as he watches Ron eating, and can’t resist sneaking out. Can Mr Bean keep himself hidden all night, especially when he needs the toilet?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (13)

But every time he goes down to collect it from the letterbox it disappears. Someone is taking it but who? Mr Bean is determined to nab the mysterious newspaper stealer and uses a range of ingenious homemade traps in his quest to catch the sneaky thief.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (14)

But instead of reading he becomes distracted by some funny online videos he sees on the Library’s computer. Before he knows it Mr Bean is recording his own video which is uploaded for everyone to see. Things start to go crazy when people check out his funny video and his popularity takes off. But does Mr Bean enjoy being in the public eye and how long will his celebrity last?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (15)
programme.desc: Mr Bean is obsessed by his favourite TV hero ‘Super Spy’ and is excited when his very own Super-Spy spy kit arrives in the post. While Mr Bean is pretending to be his favourite character and delighting in all his gadgets he spots some unusual goings on in the Bruisers’ house next door. Naturally Mr Bean assumes the worst and sets out to rectify the situation.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (2)
programme.desc: Whilst browsing the supermarket for lovely grub, Mr. Bean’s life-long pal, Teddy, is kidnapped. Bean tracks down the nasty men responsible and finds that Teddy is not their only captive. Mr. Bean rescues a hundred teddy bears once their ears are put through an industrial sewing machine.

programme.title: Batwheels (18)
programme.desc: Catwoman has her eyes on the prize at Gotham's big skateboarding competition, and it's up to Robin and Nightwing to stop her -- with some help from Ace!

programme.title: Batwheels (29)
programme.desc: After he takes down Riddler with an impressive wheel slam move, the Batwheels give Buff the nickname "Tough Buff." But Buff abruptly bristles at the name, leading the Batwheels to realize that it's not okay to call your friends nicknames that they don't like.

programme.title: Meet the Batwheels (18)
programme.desc: A music video introducing the villainous vehicle squad - The Legion of Zoom - introducing their shifty skills and pernicious personalities.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! (18)
programme.desc: The gang hits the ski slopes, although Daphne's more focused on nailing Fred with a revenge snowball. Their snowy fun is soon interrupted by the appearance of an evil Snowman Monster eager to scare all trespassers off his mountain.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! (23)
programme.desc: he gang head out to a Day of the Dead festival. There, they learn the spirit of the old, legendary criminal, El Bandito, has returned to terrorize the locals. Fred becomes obsessed with solving the mystery and becoming a part of the great legend, himself.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! (7)
programme.desc: The gang goes trick or treating on Halloween night but Velma seems to think that Halloween is a disrespect to history while Daphne, Shaggy and Scooby have the opposite opinion. Meanwhile Fred believes you can't solve a mystery on Halloween. But all is explained when the gang runs into a witch and Fred reveals that he ran into the same witch 11 years ago with his cousin.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (55)
programme.desc: An old metal box found by chance in a recess of a cliff brings back childhood memories for Grizzy and the Lemmings.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (56)
programme.desc: How can one peacefully watch a documentary on salmon fish, nice and comfy on the sofa, when the Lemmings are playing chemistry novices with a fun experiment box? By confiscating their equipment? Beware of side effects.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (57)
programme.desc: Grizzy's TV remote control is stolen by a partridge who collects high-tech objects in his nest perched high up in a tree. This is a case of absolute urgency! Grizzy has no other choice but to requisition the Lemmings propulsion game to recover his possession. But try and make a Lemming understand that!

programme.title: Lamput (29)
programme.desc: It might be Sunday, but Specs just won’t let up: his obsession with Lamput knows no weekends. Skinny, on the other hand, knows just how to spend his day off. Asleep, that’s how. Even if his workaholic buddy insists on dragging him through the usual pointless search. The call of a morning coffee wins the day, though; when Specs finally agrees to take a break, he discovers that even orange blobs like a sleep-in. And pancakes. Lots of pancakes.

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers (1)
programme.desc: The Dino Ranchers kick off their epic summer on Dino Island, ready for nonstop adventure with their fearless Uncle Jack! Jon is in awe of his uncle’s daring spirit and is determined to prove he’s just as bold! But on their very first dino-rescue mission, Jon’s efforts to impress him backfire. While Min and Miguel handle the situation with calm skill, Jon’s overzealousness only creates more chaos!

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers (2)
programme.desc: The Ranchers are thrilled to haul in a crate of sweet, rare Bramble Fruit. There’s one problem: the fruit’s outer shell is too hard to eat! Miguel unveils his latest invention, the Smooth-a-tron, a gadget that turns rock-hard Bramble Fruit into a silky-smooth, delicious drink! The team is moments away from tasting victory when a massive Quetzalcoatlus swoops down and snatches the entire crate!

programme.title: Tom and Jerry Gokko (4)

programme.desc: Tajný výzkumný projekt má oživit pokus z 2. světové války, kdy válečné lodě měly být neviditelné. Tento experiment může mít ale nedozírné následky... Pokus obnovit deset let starý vládní experiment má hrozné následky. Způsobí díru ve struktuře prostoru i času a zaviní, že se znovu objeví stará slavná válečná loď USS Eldridge z 2. světové války, která zmizela před 70 lety.

programme.title: MalinyJAMológia
programme.desc: Malované videoklipy kapely MalinyJAM milují děti na celém Slovensku. Miňo a Paťo z kapely MalinyJAM vynalezli novou vědeckou disciplínu zvanou MalinyJAMologie, jež má umožnit dětem porozumět světu zvířat a rostlin ve vzájemných souvislostech. V každé epizodě budeme pozorovat život a chování vybraného zvířátka a vysvětlovat důležitost rostlinky, která s ním souvisí. Vydejte se i vy spolu s námi na dobrodružnou poznávací jízdu! Slovenský hudebně-naučný pořad

programme.title: Kikirikí
programme.desc: Kohoutek a slepička se stali nerozlučnými kamarády. Mají se velmi rádi, v noci spí vedle sebe na bidýlku a přes den spolu gazdují na dvoře. Kohoutek neustále něco vymýšlí, je nespokojený a slepička s ním všechno trpělivě řeší. Každý příběh v sobě ukrývá ponaučení, jak se stát lepším a neubližovat lidem, kteří nás mají rádi. Slovenská pohádka

programme.title: Sníček (13)
programme.desc: Hugo splní dětem každý sen! V noci snové víly přinášejí dětem sny. Ale co dělají přes den? Hugo se nudí, a tak si usmyslí, že Lucii a Damiána bude navštěvovat i během dne. Jelikož se však neumí v našem světě chovat, děti ho musí učit základy slušné výchovy. On jim za to vysvětlí, jak fungují nejznámější hodiny na světě Big Ben, a ukáže, jak žijí různá zvířata. Vezme je do džungle, pod mořskou hladinu, do vesmíru, a také do svého snového světa, kde je možné opravdu všechno.

programme.title: Zabij nudu! II
programme.desc: Dochází vám fantazie, co dělat doma s dětmi? Je tu pořad, v němž dostanete návod, jak spolu smysluplně prožít společně strávený čas. A také jak vyrobit jedinečné věci, které oživí vaši domácnost. Zažijete přitom určitě spoustu zábavy! Jsou to věci funkční, dekorační nebo jen pro zábavu, například pomůcky do školy, pokladničky či žertovné ozdoby. Slovenský tvůrčí pořad

programme.title: Staré pověsti české (2)
programme.desc: Animované Staré pověsti české vznikly ve vlastní produkci televizí CS Film a CS Mini. Producenti televize hledali velký příběh, který by připomínal tradice a naši minulost. Jan Werich o Jiráskovi, podle jehož námětu byl seriál natočen, řekl: „Kdyby Jirásek žil v Hollywoodu, byl by milionář, protože měl výborné zápletky.“ Oslavoval český národ, ale ne na úkor jiných. Tu a tam zušlechťoval naši historii a prokládal ji sentimentálními příběhy, a tak nám ji přibližoval a činil bližší.

programme.title: Bílý tesák (4)
programme.desc: Klasické dílo světové dobrodružné literatury Bílý tesák od Jacka Londona ožívá ve dvanáctidílném seriálu, který je vytvořen originální animační technikou. Živá kresba zachycuje na pozadí nehostinné Aljašky v době vrcholící zlaté horečky osud psa, v jehož žilách koluje vlčí krev. Český animovaný seriál

programme.title: Příběhy kocoura Modroočka (3)
programme.desc: Modroočko má jemný kožíšek, velikánské modré oči, dlouhé vlasy a hebký čumáček. Je to vzdělaný kocourek, který si píše deník a bydlí u svého pána, spisovatele. Objevuje svět kolem sebe a vypráví o všech svých dvounohých a čtyřnohých přátelích. Z díry v plotu ho zachrání nový přítel - kocour Bělovous, na dovolené získá další přátele - ježka Šramotu, loveckého psa Fouska a králíka Bílé Pírko. Také se seznámí s kočičkou Kiki a popere se kvůli ní s obrovským zlomyslným kocourem Žluťákem.

programme.title: Žofka a její dobrodružství (13)
programme.desc: Veselé příběhy podnikavé opičky Žofky Orangutanové a jejích zvířecích kamarádů v zoologické zahradě. Československý animovaný seriál .

programme.title: Broučci (3)
programme.desc: Animovaný loutkový seriál na motivy knihy Jana Karafiáta. Karafiátova kniha s ilustracemi Jiřího Trnky inspirovala už celou řadu adaptací a stále patří do zlatého fondu české dětské literatury. Tato filmová verze Broučků citlivě pracuje se známými hodnotami a snaží se je co nejvíce přiblížit dnešním dětem. Český animovaný loutkový seriál

programme.title: Tisíc a jedna noc (2)
programme.desc: Animovaný seriál, jehož jednotlivé části vyprávějí příhody ze známé knihy Pohádky tisíce a jedné noci. Český animovaný seriál

programme.title: O Dorotce (5)
programme.desc: Holčička Dorotka a její věrný kamarád papoušek Koko spolu prožívají různá veselá dobrodružství. Československý animovaný seriál

programme.title: Já Baryk (5)
programme.desc: Dvanáct příběhů, z nichž každý je věnovaný vždy jednomu měsíci v roce a jednomu zvířeti, se kterým se dobromyslný pes Baryk ve svém okolí potká, to je spousta veselých i napínavých příhod.

programme.title: Mach a Šebestová (4)
programme.desc: Třída Macha a Šebestové má jít na prohlídku Zoologické zahrady, jenže bez svého spolužáka Kropáčka, který má angínu. Mach a Šebestová se tedy rozhodli, že Kropáčka vyléčí. Vzali své sluchátko a zavolali, že chtějí být tak malí, aby se vešli do krku Horáčka. Přání se jim splnilo a vyrazili s pomocí nástrojů (kladivo, koštěte aj.) na hubení bacilů... Československý animovaný seriál (1976-1983).

programme.title: Krakonošovy pohádky (8)
programme.desc: Před mnoha a mnoha lety, kdy lesy byly plné zvěře a ptactva, vládl horám u pramenů Labe Krakonoš. Na jeho kraj bylo utěšené podívání, ale o živobytí se v něm musel každý s přírodou poprat... Východoněmecko-československý animovaný loutkový seriál

programme.title: Spravedlnosti se meze nekladou
programme.desc: Tragikomický příběh dobrého soudce z období první republiky na motivy povídky Ivana Olbrachta. Dobrý soudce Engelbert Bezloja se pro svou nestrannost dostane do nesnází. Osobní důvody a dluhy přispějí k tomu, že odejde na zastrčený post. Redaktor Pekárek, kterého kdysi osvobodil, ho nachází v Beranovicích. Rád by se mu odvděčil, a tak o něm napíše potupný článek jako o zlém a krutém sadistovi. Mezitím se Bezloja zaplete s místní chudinou a vrchní rada Kunz ho definitivně zbaví úřadu.

programme.title: Až opadá listí z dubu
programme.desc: Oslava chytrosti a vtipu prostého člověka, který vyhrává nad byrokraticky důkladným a vytrvalým čertem. Československý krátkometrážní animovaný film

programme.title: Divoké pivo
programme.desc: Legrace se daří, kde se pivo vaří. Ztřeštěná komedie o privatizaci pivovaru, české mafii a policajtech. Bláznivá letní komedie o privatizaci malého jihočeského pivovaru, v níž figuruje i půvabná pohádková bytost ženského pohlaví. V řadě komediálních situací se zde setkávají dobří čeští policisté s mafií, poctiví občané s podvodníky. Úsměvný příběh, který samozřejmě nepostrádá milostnou zápletku, významně ovlivní pohádkové bytosti, které se náhle vynoří z dávné minulosti.

programme.title: Proč moskyt bzučí do lidských uší
programme.desc: Kreslená bajka podle africké pohádky, upravené americkou spisovatelkou Vernou Aardemou. Animace vychází z ilustrací Lea a Diane Dillonových k této knize. O tom, co všechno může způsobit nevinná maličkost, pokud je špatně pochopená a několikrát přemílaná. Československý animovaný film

programme.title: Kinosál
programme.desc: V pořadu o nových filmech v kinech každý týden informujeme o nejzajímavějších a nejočekávanějších titulech v naší distribuci. V krátkých reportážích se zaměříme na zákulisí vzniku filmů, kuriozity z natáčení a výpovědi tvůrců. Přineseme rozhovory s českými a slovenskými filmaři, kteří v našich končinách stále více natáčejí své autorské projekty, a zachytíme jejich tvůrčí atmosféru. Filmová publicistika

programme.title: Lelíček ve službách Sherlocka Holmese
programme.desc: Nestárnoucí filmová komedie podle humoristického románu Hugo Vavrise s Vlastou Burianem v hlavní dvojroli. Portorický král Fernando XXIII. požádá slavného detektiva Holmese, aby mu sehnal dvojníka, neboť se obává atentátu. Holmes najde v moravském Brodku notorického dlužníka Františka Lelíčka, který je králi podobný jako vejce vejci. Lelíček, pronásledovaný věřiteli, nabídku přijímá. Krásná a mladá královna odmítla se svým zbabělým manželem odjet do bezpečí v exilu.

programme.title: Jak se státi gentlemanem
programme.desc: Krátká groteska KF Praha, která byla natočena na zakázku pro BESIP (organizace Bezpečnosti silničního provozu). Automobily ovládly život moderního člověka. I pan Andělín se rozhodne získat řidičský průkaz... A jak to dopadne? Československý krátkometrážní film

programme.title: Až do konce
programme.desc: Naděje života zmařená lidskou krutostí. Válečné psychologické drama na motivy stejnojmenné novely Otakara Chaloupky Sudety, květen 1945. Skupinka ustupujících německých vojáků zajme skupinu mladých dělnic, totálně nasazených v chemické továrně. Chce je využít jako rukojmích během svého postupu k americké demarkační linii.

programme.title: Kinosál
programme.desc: V pořadu o nových filmech v kinech každý týden informujeme o nejzajímavějších a nejočekávanějších titulech v naší distribuci. V krátkých reportážích se zaměříme na zákulisí vzniku filmů, kuriozity z natáčení a výpovědi tvůrců. programme.title: Matěji, proč tě holky nechtějí?
programme.desc: Osmnáctiletý zednický učeň získává své první zkušenosti ve věcech lásky. Dospívající zednický učeň Matěj Hůrka, mladík ve věcech lásky jelimánkovitý, žije u své babičky ve venkovské chalupě. Potýká se s milostnými problémy, ale marně čeká nějakou radu, protože čilá babička se znovu vdává za neméně čiperného důchodce. Podnikavá nejstarší generace tak do jisté míry kontrastuje s mládím, které je rozpačité. Československá komedie

programme.title: Kinosál
programme.desc: V pořadu o nových filmech v kinech každý týden informujeme o nejzajímavějších a nejočekávanějších titulech v naší distribuci. programme.title: O Mikešovi (3)
programme.desc: Animovaný seriál O kocouru Mikešovi a jeho přátelích, podle knihy Josefa Lady. Československý animovaný seriál

programme.title: O Mikešovi (4)
programme.desc: Animovaný seriál O kocouru Mikešovi a jeho přátelích, podle knihy Josefa Lady. Československý animovaný seriál

programme.title: Vrať se do hrobu
programme.desc: O cestě Víti Jakoubka do mládí, do stáří a zpět. Víťa Jakoubek už překročil třicítku, pracuje jako špatně placený sociolog a žije jako spořádaný manžel a každodenními povinnostmi unavený otec dvou dětí. V sociologickém ústavu se podílí na výzkumu postojů středoškolské mládeže. Aby cílovou skupinu lépe pochopil, vydává se za studenta a denně usedá do gymnaziálních lavic. Náhle jako by se vrátil zpátky v čase, cítí se opět mladý a bezstarostný, vidí před sebou spoustu příslibů.

programme.title: Filmové minuty
programme.desc: Filmové minuty přinášejí souhrnné filmové zpravodajství ze světa filmu, aktuality, ocenění, výročí, nové a připravované projekty a mnoho dalšího z domova i ze zahraničí... Filmová publicistika

programme.title: Zatykač na královnu
programme.desc: Vyrábět potajmu alkohol se nevyplácí. Laborantka Dagmar Králová je zapletena do ilegální výroby alkoholu. Hlavní organizátor výhodných obchodů se pokusí vraždou zabránit odhalení. Na počátku případu stojí anonym, který upozorní policii na příliš nákladný život Dagmar Králové, laborantky Chemotexu. Ta zjistí, že dívka si opravdu žije nad poměry a až příliš často objíždí hotely v okolí, kde se však nikdy dlouho nezdrží. Kapitán Záruba se rozhodne ženu předvolat a záležitost s anonymem ukončit.
